svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Multi-tenant SaaS with a shared ML pipeline on AWS
svg.desc: Multi-tenant SaaS with a shared ML pipeline on AWS. 13 components in 8 groups. Connections: Tenant users to Amazon Cognito (sign in); Tenant users to Amazon API Gateway (requests); Amazon Cognito to Amazon API Gateway; Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda (tenant context); AWS Lambda to Tenant data silos (tenant's own database); AWS Lambda to Amazon SageMaker AI (predict); Tenant data silos to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams (change events); Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to AWS Glue; AWS Glue to Data lake; Data lake to Training job; Training job to Model registry; Amazon SageMaker AI to Model registry (loads model).

text.tspan: Multi-tenant SaaS with a shared ML pipeline on AWS
One control plane routes each tenant to its own Amazon Aurora database; all of them feed one shared Amazon SageMaker AI pipeline
